VERDICT done_when: the section's done-when for this wiring node asks a test to drive start-up and one renewal against a temporary fleet record naming another node with a run launched there, releasing the seat, printing the announcement once, exiting, and running the unit-disable command only through an injectable runner, with the same test on the fleet node keeping the producer running; tests/test_the_producer_calls_its_seat_decision.py does exactly that and its five tests pass at head c99a46279 (reviewer re-ran the file: 5 passed in 3.65s), while logs/gate-head.log records 2 failed / 55 passed at 12573b255 and logs/gate-base.log 4 failed / 48 passed at dc3ace589, the head set a strict subset.
